consequence.statement: The External Workloads feature still works in 1.17 but will be removed in v1.18.

original.statement: The External Workloads feature is deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-b5054e15ad6c] lists External Workloads under the 1.17 "Deprecated Options" notes and says the feature "has been deprecated and will be removed in v1.18". Removal is planned for a later release, and nothing says it fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in 1.17. That makes the consequence kind deprecation, which goes to review rather than mandatory work. The proposed statement matches this.
